subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Expressar-se e atuar em processos de criação autorais individuais e coletivos nas diferentes linguagens artísticas (artes visuais, audiovisual, dança, música e teatro) e nas intersecções entre elas, recorrendo a referências estéticas e culturais, conhecimentos de naturezas diversas (artísticos, históricos, sociais e políticos) e experiências individuais e coletivas.

components.description_pt: Expressar ideias originais através de processos criativos individuais ou coletivos em pelo menos uma linguagem artística
components.description_en: Express original ideas through individual or collective creative processes in at least one artistic language
components.cc_component_description: Express one's own ideas clearly during one-on-one, group, or teacher-led discussions

components.description_pt: Recorrer a referências estéticas, culturais e históricas para informar produção artística original
components.description_en: Draw on aesthetic, cultural, and historical references to inform original artistic production
components.cc_component_description: Draw on a wide reading of world literature to contextualize a text's cultural standpoint

components.description_pt: Engajar-se em processos criativos que intersectam diferentes linguagens artísticas como artes visuais, música, dança, teatro ou audiovisual
components.description_en: Engage in creative processes that intersect different artistic languages such as visual arts, music, dance, theater, or audiovisual
components.cc_component_description: Compare how a subject or key scene is represented in two different artistic mediums

components.description_pt: Incorporar experiências individuais e coletivas em produções artísticas originais
components.description_en: Incorporate individual and collective experiences into original artistic productions
components.cc_component_description: Develop and describe characters and their relationships within an original narrative

cc_matches.description: Analyze the representation of a subject or a key scene in two different artistic mediums, including what is emphasized or absent in each treatment (e.g., Auden's "Musée des Beaux Arts" and Breughel's Landscape with the Fall of Icarus).

Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 3 topics and texts, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.
Analyze a particular point of view or cultural experience reflected in a work of literature from outside the United States, drawing on a wide reading of world literature.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar relatos para...
* orientar a la audiencia sobre el contexto
* desarrollar y describir personajes y sus relaciones
* realizar una historia con una temática o con problemática y desenlace, tiempo y secuencia de eventos
* adaptarse a la audiencia
* captar al lector a través de textos multimodales complejos bilingües
* conectar historias orales y escritas a través de textos multiculturales y/o translingüísticos
